audience: anyone who has watched a World Cup
summary: Too easy for Today's list: eight of the top 10 are the football powers anyone names, so a casual player finds all 10 and a fan sweeps it. Clean, current data and a deep pool of countries make it a great Blitz.
reasons: Casual found 10/10 in 14 guesses but lost 4 lives on Portugal (#13), USA (#21), Mexico (#11) and Croatia (#18), each showing its win count. A US player who barely follows soccer still found 7. The fan swept it in 10 guesses without losing a life, so there is no stretch answer and the curve is flat.

The data matches Wikipedia's all-time table through 2026, the year Spain won. West Germany, USSR and Yugoslavia go to their successors, 'czechoslovakia' offers both successors, the home nations are separate ('uk' asks about England) and countries that never played say so. Clubs, players and 'soccer' are all free.
Blitz: 26 of 28 quick names score, down to Wales and Canada. Only teams with no wins (Qatar, China) score nothing.
fixes: Drop `debut: true` from world-cup-wins in scripts/topics.ts: judged too easy for Today's list, it would otherwise wait out of random play for good.
